subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 10: Over to you! – Unit review
outcomes: Review Unit 1 words about the environment and extreme weather.
Use modal verbs and reported questions and commands correctly.
Check your own progress in Unit 1.

tf.s: Harriet gave her birthday money to a panda charity.
tf.why: Yes, Harriet helped an endangered animal.

tf.s: Faris made a statue from rubbish he found on the beach.
tf.why: Correct! He turned rubbish into art.

tf.s: Leo said a sandstorm destroyed a lot of homes in his town.
tf.why: Leo talked about floods: the river water destroyed a lot of homes.

tf.s: “We mustn’t destroy the rainforests” is correct.
tf.why: Great! Destroying rainforests is not allowed.

tf.s: ‘Do you save water?’ is reported as “I asked you if you saved water.”
‘Don’t say the word!’ is reported as “I told you to don’t say the word.”
tf.why: We say I told you not to say the word.

tf.s: Recycling and planting trees are problems for our planet.
tf.why: They are ways to help our planet.

tf.s: A heatwave is a very hot period of weather.
tf.why: Right! Heatwaves bring very high temperatures.

tf.s: “You needn’t switch off the lights” means it is not allowed to switch them off.
tf.why: Needn’t means it is not necessary.

tf.s: The WOW! question of Unit 1 is “What can we do to protect our planet?”
tf.why: Yes, the whole unit answers this question.

boxes.q: Who made a statue from rubbish found on the beach?
Who gave birthday money to a panda charity?

boxes.why: It is necessary not to destroy them.

o: I told you to spell the word cyclone aloud.
I asked you if spell cyclone.
She asked me if I recycled.
She asked me do I recycle.

boxes.q: What destroyed homes in Leo’s town?
boxes.why: It rained so much that the river flooded homes.

boxes.q: Which is a way to protect our planet?
We ___ plant trees. (the right thing to do)
Report: ‘How many letters are in the word drought?’
o: I asked you how many letters were in the word drought.
I asked you how many letters are there in drought?
I told you how many letters in drought.
boxes.why: Keep the question word and change are to were.

mcq.q: What did Leo say about floods in his town?
o: It rained so much that the river water destroyed a lot of homes.
There was no rain for a long time.
The sand covered all the cars.

mcq.q: Which modal verb means “it is the right thing to do”?
Which word is an extreme weather word?
Who has helped an endangered animal?
mcq.why: Harriet gave money to a panda charity.

mcq.q: Report: ‘Don’t say the word but mime it.’
o: I told you not to say the word but to mime it.
I told you don’t say the word.
I asked you if you said the word.
I told you to not saying the word.
mcq.why: told + you + not to + verb … but to + verb.

o: We mustn’t to use mobile phones.
We needn’t to use mobile phones.

mcq.q: Make a sentence with a modal verb using the flashcard “plant trees”.
Why is Faris’s statue a good idea for the planet?
o: He used rubbish from the beach, so the beach is cleaner.
He bought new plastic for it.
He destroyed a tree to make it.
It uses a lot of energy.
mcq.why: Using beach rubbish helps keep the beach clean.

mcq.q: Which pair shows a problem and a solution from Unit 1?
Find the mistake: “She asked me where did I live.”
mcq.why: Reported questions use normal word order.
